Marcel —

Appreciate you sending the docs. Quick answers below, then a couple of action items so our vendor onboarding team can finish the PO setup.

What we need to accept the NL certificate:
- A scanned copy of the VAT certificate showing DeltaWorks BV and the VAT number (you provided — thank you).
- Confirmation of the legal invoicing name + registered address (please ensure these match the vendor profile in the spreadsheet).
- A short attestation (one-page) signed by an authorized rep that the VAT number belongs to the invoicing entity.

PO split format:
- We prefer a simple CSV with columns: po_number, line_item, amount, currency, vendor_entity, vendor_vat_number, invoice_to_address.
- I've attached a po-split-template.csv that matches our AP ingestion.

Next steps (action items):
1) Can you add a signed attestation PDF to this thread? That will let AP accept the NL VAT certificate.
2) Use the attached template for any required PO splits and return as CSV. For recurrent multi-entity deals we keep the CSV stored in our procurement system and map incoming invoices to the split lines.
